headline: Mooring County Front Re-Ignites as Linn of Mercy and Stonecradle Churn
war_summary: Combat has surged with renewed ferocity across the northern and central sectors. In Mooring County, Colonial forces have re-established a contested foothold, prompting six base turnovers in the past two hours around Wiccwalk and The Wind Hills as fighting accelerated straight to the wire. Immediately south, Linn of Mercy witnessed an equally violent flare-up, generating six fresh strategic exchanges that left the Wardens clinging to a lone strongpoint while both sides suffered over twenty-two hundred casualties in two hours. Stonecradle remains a bitterly divided sector, recording three base captures across the same span while absorbing another thirty-two hundred dead. Simultaneously, an intense clash has unexpectedly erupted along the frozen frontier of Nevish Line, where combined losses spiked past seventeen hundred in two hours beneath heavy enlistments, though lines have yet to break. Across the east, Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf endure punishing attrition exceeding a thousand casualties per hour without further ground shifting hands, while the western waters off Fisherman's Row have fallen completely quiet under firm Colonial rule.
